title: The purpose of this meeting is to continue the Committee's interim work. The Committee will consider legislation relating to worker's compensation mental health coverage for emergency communications professionals and ski patrol. The Wyoming Board of Nursing will present information regarding required education for varying levels of licensure and discuss enrollment issues pertaining to Certified Nursing Assistant programs.
